basis: The Organization page and the Impressum call the ZKM a foundation under public law with the state and the city as sponsors; the Rechnungshof Baden-Württemberg Denkschrift 2017, Beitrag Nr. 22, reports its audit of the ZKM's budget and management.

governance.parent: City of Kassel and State of Hesse (shareholders)

basis: The imprint on fridericianum.org names documenta und Museum Fridericianum gGmbH (AG Kassel, HRB 2154) and says the City of Kassel and the State of Hesse are its shareholders.
The legal notice names Performance Electrics gGmbH as the responsible party for the E-WERK Luckenwalde site, and the Info page calls E-WERK a not-for-profit institution.

The About page says Stiftung Kunsthalle Mainz was recognised on 12 February 2007, was created by Stadtwerke Mainz AG as founder and is the Trägerin of the Kunsthalle; the Impressum names the foundation as Träger.

controls: approval of programme, loans or disposals by a ministry or council

basis: The Betriebssatzung für den Eigenbetrieb Kunsthalle Mannheim (in force from 14 November 2025), section 1 and section 5 numbers 2, 3, 6, 8, 9 and 11, makes it a city Eigenbetrieb whose Gemeinderat appoints the director, sets the Wirtschaftsplan and decides loans and disposals above set values; section 5 number 3 refers to its employees and civil servants.
The Impressum says Die Neue Sammlung is a state museum (staatliches Museum) and part of the Bayerische Staatliche Museen.

The imprint names Stiftung Haus der Kunst München, gemeinnützige Betriebsgesellschaft mbH (Munich HRB 100018) as the responsible body, and the support page lists the Free State of Bavaria as a shareholder.

The statutes of the Kunstverein München e.V. adopted on 19 August 2021, section 1 (register of associations) and section 9 paragraph 4, say the Board may employ and dismiss a Director and other employees.
The museum's About us page describes the Lenbachhaus as a municipal museum.

governance.parent: Kulturreferat of the City of Munich

basis: The City of Munich page says the Lothringer 13 Halle is a cultural institution of the Kulturreferat of the Landeshauptstadt München.
